title: Esha Singh Kaun Hai? 🎯 21 Saal Ki Shooter Ka Kamaal! 5 Facts #shorts
description:
Esha Singh kaun hai? Sirf 21 saal ki shooter jisne Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker ko bhi pachhad diya! 🎯🇮🇳
Hyderabad ki is shooter ki kahani 5 facts mein.

ISSF World Cup Hangzhou – 40 hits ke saath gold • Asian Games – 5 shoot-off, silver • World Championship Doha – Esha, Manu aur Divya ka team gold (1761 points) • South Korea aur Vietnam ko peeche chhoda • Championship mein Bharat ka doosra gold

Agle Olympic mein Esha gold laayegi? Haan ya Na – comment karo! 👇
